fallback: There is no actual LLM integration yet. Please use the questions about pricing for now.

entries.question: Is TigerLegs free?
entries.answer: Yes. TigerLegs is under development, we are looking for testers, and for now everything is completely free.

entries.question: Will extracting segments stay free?
entries.answer: Yes. Loading a GPX file and getting its swim and run segments, with distances, on a map and in a table, will always be free.

entries.question: What will Silver, Gold and Platinum cost?
entries.answer: The draft prices are €5 for Silver, €10 for Gold and €25 for Platinum. Whether that is per month or per year is not decided yet, and nothing can be bought yet.

entries.question: Why is there a membership at all?
entries.answer: Today TigerLegs costs almost nothing to run. Once we build a back end that also hosts profiles, we pay for servers, storage and backups, and the membership covers those costs.

entries.question: Will hosting my profile cost money?
entries.answer: No. Hosting your profile is a planned feature, and it stays in the free tier.

entries.question: For how many courses can I plan energy stations?
entries.answer: In the draft: at most 2 courses or races for free, 5 for Silver, 10 for Gold and unlimited for Platinum.

entries.question: Do I need a membership for the Garmin watch?
entries.answer: In the draft, the Garmin watch integration is part of Silver, Gold and Platinum. It is a planned feature, so nothing is decided yet.
